Favicon.status: Documented — standalone COMPONENT (no variants), no exposed instances. Built internally on private helper set ".Brand Favicon" (6 variants, one per brand) but exposes no properties of its own — instantiated as a fixed asset.

Brand Logo.status: Documented — self-contained, no exposed instances. Built internally on private helper set ".Logo" (34 variants) but exposes no nested properties — configured entirely via its own componentPropertyDefinitions (Company, Type, Alignment, Size).

Brand App Icons.status: Documented — flat asset family, no shared COMPONENT_SET or variant properties across the 31 standalone COMPONENTs (per-platform/per-brand app icon exports).

illustrations.status: Documented — 173 illustrations across 10 categories, each a self-contained COMPONENT_SET with a single Size variant (Banner/Hero/Picto/Spot). 172/173 compose one exposed .Alerts - Tag sub-instance (Style x Size x Type) for per-brand rendering; one has none (flagged). The HP category holds 2 standalone HeroIllus COMPONENTs (flat asset family, no shared set) instead.
